items.headline: Launches Catastrophism Research Association and Havenbound
items.summary: Davidson and associates, including Stephanie Buchanan, launched a research body on cyclical geophysical cataclysm, alongside Havenbound, a location-risk tool tied to the pole shift.

items.headline: Inversion — ECDO Theory
items.summary: Most recent article found by search. Announces a forthcoming work, "A New Knowledge," which he says explains the mechanism behind cataclysm, tradition and climate; check his X feed for newer posts.

items.headline: Co-launches the Catastrophism Research Association
items.summary: Named among the founders of a new research body studying cyclical geophysical cataclysm.

items.headline: Comments on Craig Stone's ECDO simulation

items.headline: Havenbound opens to the public
items.summary: Announced public launch after about a year of development; the service produces a safety report for any coordinate on Earth.
